record.worldSummary: The game recreates late-16th-century Japan across castle towns, ports, shrines, countryside and forests. Seasonal changes alter vegetation, water, visibility and infiltration opportunities, while a spy network and scouts help uncover targets and locations.

record.worldSummary: Bayonetta travels through Noatun and realms including Paradiso and Inferno while attempting to rescue Jeanne’s soul. The journey deepens the series’ mythology and brings Bayonetta into direct conflict with angels, demons and masked rivals.

storyChapters.title: Jeanne’s Soul

storyChapters.body: Bayonetta travels through Noatun toward the sacred mountain while confronting angels, demons and a masked Lumen Sage.

storyChapters.title: Across Time
storyChapters.body: Events connect Bayonetta’s past and present and expand the mythology established by the first game.

record.perfNotes: The Switch version uses 720p in both docked and handheld modes and targets 60 fps. Docked performance is generally stronger; demanding scenes can still fall below the target.

handheld.notes: Portable mode renders at 720p and targets 60 fps. Complex combat can fall below the target, with handheld performance generally less consistent than docked.

tv.notes: Docked mode renders at 720p and targets 60 fps, with improved performance compared with the Wii U release but not a perfect locked 60 fps.

faq.q: Does Bayonetta 2 work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes through backward compatibility where Nintendo marks the Nintendo Switch release as supported. This file does not classify it as a native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

faq.q: What language is the supplier version of Bayonetta 2?
faq.a: Supplier listing language supplied by the user: Simplified Chinese. Official/regional language details are preserved separately in supported_languages_raw and nintendo_notes so the supplier SKU is not generalized to every region.

faq.q: Is Bayonetta 2 multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes. The file records the supported local/online modes individually.

faq.q: Why are some Switch 2 performance resolution fields blank for Bayonetta 2?
faq.a: Because exact measured Switch 2 backward-compatibility rendering values were not verified. The template is intentionally left blank rather than filled with hardware maximums or guesses.

record.verdictSummary: One of the strongest modern character-action games, combining fluid combat, excellent encounter pacing and enormous spectacle. The Switch version’s 720p presentation is modest, but its portability and strong performance make it a particularly good Nintendo release.

faq.q: How long is the main story?
faq.a: Game8 estimates roughly 55-60 hours for the main story and 100+ hours to explore all jobs, side scenarios and endings.

faq.q: Is the soundtrack new?
faq.a: The remaster retains the original soundtrack composed by Revo.

faq.q: What is new on Switch 2?
faq.a: HD visuals, redesigned UI, event fast-forward, adjustable encounter behavior, updated networking and two Joy-Con 2 mouse minigames.

faq.q: Does it use the Brave and Default system?
faq.a: Yes. The signature BP-based turn system is preserved.

faq.q: Is it multiplayer?
faq.a: The core adventure is single-player.

faq.q: Does the Western Nintendo release list Chinese?
faq.a: Western Nintendo listings commonly list Japanese and major European languages; Chinese availability should be verified against the exact Asian SKU being sold.

record.verdictSummary: A strong preservation and modernization of a landmark turn-based JRPG, retaining the deep Brave/Default and job systems while adding practical Switch 2 conveniences.
verdictCons: Western Nintendo listing does not include Chinese among supported languages
